sources.title: GitHub - polarisagi/polaris
sources.snippet: Most AI agents are built around an infinite loop: keep asking the LLM "what's next" and let the model decide where the system goes. This is like a car with no brakes — one hallucination and the whole task can spiral or collapse. Polaris strips the model of control over execution flow entirely. Every step is governed by a deterministic finite state machine (FSM) written in Go: when to proceed ...
